data.body_html:
Crossing the finish line of Ironman 2048 in Marbella is a monumental achievement. After months of training and a gruelling race day, your body and mind deserve more than a hotel pool. A marbella yacht charter ironman 2048 recovery day offers the ultimate post-race reset: gentle sea breezes, cold drinks, and zero pressure. Departing from Puerto Banús, our fleet provides private, all-inclusive escapes starting from €749 for two hours. Whether you choose a compact speedboat or a luxurious 29-metre flybridge, every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. No planning, no stress — just recovery on the Mediterranean.

This guide covers everything you need to know: which boats suit your group size, what’s included, and how to book. For a full overview of our fleet and pricing, visit our Marbella yacht charter hub.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for Ironman Recovery?

Post-race recovery isn’t just about rest — it’s about active recovery in a calming environment. A yacht charter allows you to float on calm waters, soak up vitamin D, and enjoy light movement without taxing your muscles. The Costa del Sol in late summer offers water temperatures around 24°C and air temperatures of 30°C, perfect for a gentle swim or simply lounging on deck. Our charters include unlimited water, isotonic drinks, and light snacks to help rehydrate and refuel. Plus, the gentle rocking of the boat can aid muscle relaxation and mental decompression.

Our Fleet for Post-Race Charters

We offer boats for every group size and budget. All depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella’s premier marina. Below is a selection of our most popular recovery vessels:

For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) offer intimate escapes. Larger parties can book the Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) or Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax). All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT.

What’s Included in Every Charter

All our charters are fully inclusive. You won’t pay extra for the essentials:

  • Licensed, English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (chips, nuts, fruit)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) — no hidden taxes

For the Mangusta 80 (both white and grey variants), a jet ski is included free of charge — ideal if you want a quick adrenaline hit or a fun way to explore coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés.

Best Routes for Post-Race Relaxation

After Ironman, your muscles need gentle movement, not pounding waves. Our skippers recommend calm-water routes:

  • Puerto Banús to Cabopino — 6 nautical miles east, past the dunes of Artola. Sheltered waters, shallow beaches for a easy swim.
  • Puerto Banús to Cala del Faro — 4 nautical miles west, a quiet cove with crystal-clear water. Perfect for floating on a paddleboard (available on request).
  • Golden Mile Cruise — stay close to shore, viewing Marbella’s skyline and La Concha mountain. Ideal for sunset with a glass of cava.

All routes avoid open-sea swell. Your skipper will adjust based on weather and your energy levels.

How to Book Your Recovery Charter

Booking is straightforward. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can book directly online at the fixed prices: €749 for 2 hours, €1,399 for 4 hours, or €2,299 for 8 hours. For Tier B (Mangusta 80), the minimum is 4 hours at €4,719. For all other boats, including the Ferretti 94, K80, or Lagoon 380, simply contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during Ironman week when demand peaks. For more details on each boat, return to our Marbella yacht charter hub.

Frequently asked questions

What is included in a post-Ironman recovery yacht charter?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You just bring yourself and your swimsuit.

How much does a recovery charter cost for Ironman athletes?

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B (Mangusta 80) is €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Which boat is best for a small group of Ironman finishers?

For up to 5 people, the Dubhe (8m) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m) are ideal. For up to 8, the Bandido (11.5m) or Red Tide (11m) work well. All depart from Puerto Banús.

Can we bring our own food or drinks on board?

Our charters already include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. You are welcome to bring additional food, but glass bottles are not permitted for safety.

How long is a typical recovery day charter?

Most guests book a half-day (4 hours) or full-day (8 hours). A 2-hour sunset cruise is also popular for a quick unwind. All options include the same amenities.

Where do we depart from for the Ironman recovery charter?

All boats depart from Puerto Banús in Marbella. We can also arrange pick-ups from Marbella Marina or Cabopino upon request, subject to availability.

Is there a jet ski included in any charter?

Yes, the Mangusta 80 (both white and grey variants) includes a free jet ski for the duration of the charter. This is perfect for a post-race thrill or exploring the coast.

How do I book a yacht for Ironman 2048 recovery?

Book directly via WhatsApp for any boat not listed with fixed pricing. For Tier A and B boats, you can also contact us through the website. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance.
